Kentucky notified employers in May 2026 that the unemployment-insurance tax release schedule changed.
A June 2026 KUIP newsletter said the new employer tax system was scheduled for August 17, 2026.
evidence.caution: This is a dated planned-launch statement from June 2026, not independent verification of current post-launch status.

evidence.finding: Post-launch verification on 2026-09-24 confirms the KUIP Employer and TPA portals are live. The June 2026 August 17 launch notice is therefore superseded as a future-planning statement.

Current Kentucky guidance places employer tax/account maintenance, wage reporting, payments and charge-statement viewing in KUIP, while fact finding, claims correspondence and appeals filing remain in legacy systems during the Benefits & Appeals bridging period.
